gaps.title: Missing API and UI endpoints for Epidemiological Protocols management
gaps.jtbd: When an epidemiologist accesses the system, I want to search, view, and manage epidemiological protocols, so that standardized outbreak procedures and guidelines are accessible.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given seeded epidemiological protocols in the database, When a client queries protocol search or CRUD endpoints, Then the system returns matching protocol entities with search and filter capabilities.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires cataloging, search, and management of epidemiological protocols ('протоколами'), but the codebase only provides repository-level entities and seeds without any REST controllers or UI components.
